text: Before a single source gets registered in Purview, we whiteboard the structure the whole program hangs on: one governance domain, three collections, and a real ownership model.
Veridian Data Governance holds one collection per division -- Retail, Logistics, and Financial Services -- not one per technology, because scans, access, and ownership all inherit downward from here.

Every collection gets two distinct roles: a business owner accountable for what the data means, and a technical steward accountable for its structure and quality. Both get assigned before anything gets scanned.
That roster -- named owner, named steward, per collection -- is the first thing a compliance auditor will ask for, and it's signed off by all three division leads before Lesson 8 begins.
The structure is in place. Next: resolving the one term Veridian's three teams have been defining three different ways.
